title: Integrating a Figure into the Background
content: BadCoyoteasks: "Do you have any advice for artists struggling to match foreground characters and background elements into a seamless pic?"Vibert1. Overlap an element in front of the main figure.Sorolla2. Be sure lighting is consistent on the figure and the background.Sorolla3. Cast a shadow on the figure from some other element in the scene.Siemiradzki4. Match color balance between figure and ground and vary the lighting in your scene.Signorini5. Selectively soften some edges, and link some tones with the background.-----Read more on GurneyJourney:Five Ways to Extend a StoryRepoussoir figuresTopic: Composition
